What it is: handoffd supervisor's reaper substring-matches the project root, killing nested and sibling-project daemons
What it solves: ROOT CAUSE (verified in the live tree, not inferred). handoffd_supervisor.bb's
`handoffd-pids-for-root` decides what to kill with a bare substring test over the
whole process command line (swarmforge/scripts/handoffd_supervisor.bb:195):
How it works: Only a daemon whose root IS the project root is reaped
